item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Evolutionary Dynamics and Collective Intelligence on Graphs and Hypergraphs (LUISS G.Carli ROMA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-16 23:59
Institution: LUISS G.Carli ROMA, Roma
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-04 Fisica teorica della materia, modelli, metodi matematici e applicazioni

The project, developed within CODYBE and primarily aligned with FIS Line 2.3 “Higher-order evolutionary processes,” proposes a theoretical and computational study of how social interactions and network structure shape collective intelligence. A general model of collective tasks will be analyzed, and its predictions will be compared with behavioral experiments. The research is structured into two main lines: 1. Strategy evolution: evolutionary game theory will be used to study how individual adaptation affects collective performance beyond cooperation rates. 2.Higher-order interactions: hypergraph models of group interactions will be compared with pairwise network models. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Analysis and characterization of nanostructured materials with high specific surface area for the reversible absorption of energy-carrying gases. (Univ. della CALABRIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-24 12:00
Institution: Univ. della CALABRIA, Rende
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-03 Fisica sperimentale della materia e applicazioni

This position is part of the “MEDUSAH” project, which aims to engineer metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) for the ultra-efficient and sustainable storage of hydrogen based on adsorption processes. In this context, research activities will focus on the characterization and development of microporous materials with high specific surface area for reversible adsorption processes, with the ultimate goal of improving and/or surpassing the technologies currently used for the storage of energy-carrying gases.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Sviluppo di detector a cascata quantica basati su Ge/SiGe quantum wells per fotonica integrata nel medio infrarosso - 2026_CDR_DFIS_9 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-03 Fisica sperimentale della materia e applicazioni

The research activities are in the framework of the MIDSENSE project. MIDSENSE aims to develop and experimentally validate a fully integrated mid-infrared (MIR) sensing platform based entirely on silicon-compatible photonics technologies. The core objective is the realization of Ge/SiGe Quantum Cascade Detectors (QCDs)[1,2] monolithically integrated within silicon photonic circuits to enable compact, scalable, and low-noise molecular sensing systems operating in the MIR fingerprint region.
